pr_title: fix: Fix panic with empty delta scan, or empty parquet scan with a provided schema
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/19876
Fixes https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/19854
Fixes https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/19890

For the case when `scan_parquet` is done on an empty directory and `schema` was given, we should return an empty DataFrame. Currently this case isn't accounted for in some areas of the code causing some errors / panics.

Also fixes a mypy lint issue due to a new pydantic release

issue_context.title: Reading empty delta table panics
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl
path = "asd.delta"
df =  pl.DataFrame({}, [("p", pl.Int64)])
df.write_delta(path, mode="append")
pl.read_delta(path)
```


### Log output

```shell
thread '<unnamed>' panicked at C:\a\polars\polars\crates\polars-core\src\utils\mod.rs:743:34:
called `Option::unwrap()` on a `None` value
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "D:\pl-bug.py", line 6, in <module>
    pl.read_delta(path)
  File "C:\APPS\Python311\Lib\site-packages\polars\io\delta.py", line 149, in read_delta
    return df.collect()
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "C:\APPS\Python311\Lib\site-packages\polars\lazyframe\frame.py", line 2029, in collect
    return wrap_df(ldf.collect(callback))
                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
pyo3_runtime.PanicException: called `Option::unwrap()` on a `None` value
```


### Issue description

Writing and then reading a empty dataframe to a new delta table fails. Maybe related: https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/19854
It works on `polars==1.12.0`.

### Expected behavior

It should not crash and read back the written data.
